verdict.rationale: The Search API is described as offering 'content extraction for developers', and the Agent API has a built-in URL fetch tool whose results are returned inline. This suggests page content can be retrieved beyond plain snippets. However, no evidence says the full page text or markdown is returned to the developer, and the CLI is described as returning 'query-relevant page snippets', which points to snippet-style extraction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-page text or markdown output fields, a response schema showing extracted content, any format options or length limits, and hands-on corroboration.
